LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Policy_Tip: Manage policies for automatic mech upgrades.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Policy_Mech_Selector: Only list the upgrades a type of mech can have, and preview what this policy gives it. This doesn't change the policy: a policy applies to every mech it's assigned to.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Settings_UseDefault: Use the default policy for mechs without one
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Settings_UseDefault_Tip: Warning: mechs without a policy will follow the default policy, and upgrades it doesn't allow will be removed at an auto mech upgrader. A new policy allows nothing until you tick upgrades in it.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Settings_ManualDialog: Always show the configure dialog when you insert a mech yourself
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Settings_ManualDialog_Tip: When off, a mech with a policy that wants changes has it applied straight away instead. Either way, a mech with a policy goes back to matching it the next time it checks.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Settings_Interval_Tip: How often, in in-game hours, a mech checks whether its policy wants changes. Each check varies by up to 20%. Assigning a policy triggers a check right away.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Policy_LoadSet_Tip: Make this policy allow exactly the upgrades in one of your saved upgrade sets. Upgrade sets are saved from the mech upgrader's configure dialog.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Policy_LoadSet_Confirm: Replace what {0} allows with the {2} upgrades in "{1}"?
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Preview_ChooseMech: Choose a mech type with "Show upgrades for" to see what this policy gives it.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Preview_Points: A {0} gets {1} of its {2} upgrade points:
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Preview_PointsUnknown: A {0} gets upgrades worth {1} points. There's no {0} in the colony to read its upgrade points from, so the point limit is ignored.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Preview_Footer: For a mech with no upgrades, with every allowed upgrade in stock. Upgrades are picked in name order. A mech keeps the allowed upgrades it already has, and only gets upgrades that are in its auto upgrader's linked storages.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Gizmo_Policy_Desc: Choose the upgrade policy for the selected mechs. A mech with a policy goes to an auto mech upgrader by itself, to fit the upgrades its policy allows and have the rest removed.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Gizmo_CheckNow_Desc: Check this mech's upgrades against its policy now, instead of at its next regular check. If its policy wants changes that an auto mech upgrader can make, the mech goes there when it's free.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Status_Unmanaged: No upgrade policy: its upgrades are left alone.
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Status_Unstocked: Wanted, but not in any auto upgrader's linked storages: {0}
LanguageData.MU_Upgrades_Ui_Status_Click: Click to open its upgrades tab.
